_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for closed-loop-zout-pex on the `klt sim`
harness (issue #278). The per-experiment half of the adapter contract:
sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py owns the record MECHANICS and takes
every piece of ARGUMENT from this file.
Claim: Closed-loop AC output impedance at vref across the full PVT grid, through the same generated PEX DUT and the same seeded-op shape as sim/closed-loop-psrr-pex's klt bench: a 1 A / 0 deg AC test current injected directly at vref (DC = 0, so the seeded operating point is unperturbed), Zout = db(v(vref)). The DC and 1 kHz columns are expected to sit near the pre-#272 record's values; the 100 kHz+ columns are expected to MOVE -- the refreshed extraction carries 44 coupling caps and 843 wire resistors where the old one carried 9 and 77, and vref's loading is exactly where that difference lives. NOT a claim against any ratified spec row.
Netlist provenance: layout/bandgap_top/bandgap_top.pex.spice (#272's trim-bearing re-extraction) + design/netlist/bandgap_top.spice (three subckts, flattened), transformed by sim/tools/gen_pex_netlist_body.py --cell top -- the DUT body is generated, never hand-transcribed.
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in sim/pdk.json; OSDI models built by sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (local) / baked into the batch runner image (#277).
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points)
